newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Helix shares surge in active trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Helix shares surge in active trade.

text.p: Shares in Gawler Craton gold hopeful Helix Resources NL jumped 26 cents to A$4.61, their highest level since October 1987, amid speculation of further positive results from its drilling programme in the fashionable South Australian gold region and on strong offshore interest.
Brokers said with Helix's drilling programme continuing, speculation had been that the company had made further finds.

"The talk is that they have replicated the finds thay have had in other areas of the region," said a Sydney resource analyst, adding that much of the volume was likely to sourced from offshore following a roadshow.
"They have been off overseas drumming up support so that could be giving it a push too."
Explorers with interests in the highly prospective region have been star performers in the Australian market since Helix reported promising drilling results on November 18, 1996.
Helix shares have been the most spectacular performer among companies in the region, rocketing from 45 cents on November 15, 1996, to the new heights scaled today.
By 12.40 p.m. (0140 GMT), Helix shares were 20 cents higher at A$4.55 on turnover of 6.3 million shares.
